s: to mix (cause two or more substances to become combined or united)
to mix (combine several tracks; produce a finished version)
mixen.et: Borrowed from English mix, from Middle English mixen, partially inherited from Old English mixen, and partially from a backformation of Old French mixte, itself a borrowing from Latin mixtus, past participle of miscere. Doublet of mischen.
